parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

parameters.name: GetSourceDetail
parameters.description: Specifies whether to obtain details about the source instance or cluster.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SourceDBClusterDescription
parameters.description: The description of the source cluster.

parameters.name: SourceDBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source cluster. You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~170879~~) operation to query backup set IDs.

>  If you want to restore the data of an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster, this parameter is required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-sync-job-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id am-8vb39udfi356l9psq --source-db-type sls --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --source-db-cluster-id pc-t4n766v2llx852n81 --source-db-cluster-description test --get-source-detail true --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb DescribeSyncJobList --region cn-hangzhou --SourceDBClusterId 'pc-t4n766v2llx852n81' --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --SourceDBClusterDescription test --DBClusterId 'am-8vb39udfi356l9psq' --SourceDBType sls --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --GetSourceDetail true
